generator: ElevenLabs Sound Effects v2 (eleven_text_to_sound_v2) via the project owner's ElevenLabs account
processing: Each take was trimmed to its first footfall or action, softened (80 Hz high-pass, 5.5 kHz low-pass, gentle 3:1 compression; the tense set keeps its top end), faded out and levelled so every variant sits within about 3 dB of its set. The campfire loop was only filtered and levelled, so its seamless loop point is kept.
selection: Four takes were generated per sound. Takes with a second hit, near-silence or a sharp click were rejected by measurement.
